description: Godot run: start the game (main scene, the current scene, or a given scene). Returns a run_id; read errors and prints with godot_run_output, stop with godot_run_stop.

break_on_errors.description: Process mode: stop at script errors like the editor does (default false: errors are recorded, the game keeps running).

breakpoints.description: Process mode: breakpoints set before the first frame, e.g. ["res://player.gd:42"]. Inspect with godot_debug_state.

headless.description: Process mode only: no window. Defaults to true when no display is available.

quit_after_frames.description: Process mode only: quit automatically after N frames (handy for smoke tests).

scene.description: "main" (default), "current" (editor only), or a scene path like "res://levels/test.tscn".

write_movie.description: Process mode: record frames to this file with Godot's Movie Maker (.avi, or .png for an image sequence), e.g. "user://capture.avi". Needs a window.

name: godot_run_start
title: Run game
